test_title: PYST 3: SSC CGL Tier - II (English) (Held on: 29 Jan 2022)
subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

REMORSE
solution:
The correct answer is '**Satisfaction**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate **antonym** of the given word '**Remorse**' is '**Satisfaction**'.
 
• **Remorse**: a feeling of sadness because you have done something wrong. [पश्‍चात्ताप (ग़लती करने का दुख), ग्‍लानि, अनुताप]
 
 
• *Example: She was filled with **remorse** for what she had done.*
 
 
 
• **Satisfaction**: the feeling of pleasure that you have when you have done, got, or achieved what you wanted; something that gives you this feeling. [संतुष्टि (अभीष्‍ट उद्देश्‍य या वस्‍तु की उपलब्धि या कार्य को संपन्‍न करने पर प्रसन्‍नता); संतुष्टि देने वाली वस्‍तु]
 
 
• *Example: We finally found a solution that was to everyone’s satisfaction.*

 
 
 

**Correct Answer:__** *Satisfaction.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Let's look at the meaning of other words:
 
 
• **Satisfaction**: fulfilment of one's wishes, expectations, or needs, or the pleasure derived from this.[किसी की इच्छाओं, अपेक्षाओं, या जरूरतों की पूर्ति]
 
• **Regret**: to feel sorry that you did something or that you did not do something. [दुखी या खिन्‍न होना (कुछ कर देने या न कर पाने के लिए)]
 
• **Empathy**: the ability to imagine how another person is feeling and so understand his/her mood. (समानुभूति, अन्‍य व्‍यक्ति की भावनाओं को समझने की क्षमता; तादात्‍म्‍य)
